agreements_required_party.name: agreements_required_party
agreements_required_party.value: ("agreements"."type" = 'buying' and "agreements"."seller_id" is not null) or ("agreements"."type" <> 'buying' and "agreements"."customer_id" is not null)

agreements_hp_terms.name: agreements_hp_terms
agreements_hp_terms.value: "agreements"."type" <> 'hire_purchase' or ("agreements"."installment_frequency" is not null and "agreements"."installment_duration" > 0 and "agreements"."starting_date" is not null)

cars_identifier_present.name: cars_identifier_present
cars_identifier_present.value: "cars"."chassis_no" is not null or "cars"."reg_no" is not null
